gbm_population_evidence.quote: The type and grade of glioma to follow the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, allowing Grade III and IV gliomas.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma appears only in keywords and in an outcome (bevacizumab naive recurrent glioblastoma), not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; grade III and IV gliomas are eligible.

candidate_evidence.quote: 186RNL will be infused through the CED catheter at the predetermined dose.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have malignant glioma that has progressed on or after standard treatment (surgery, radiotherapy, and/or chemotherapy)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Spectroscopic imaging will then be obtained at predefined time points to visualize the distribution of the 186RNL as well as calculated the actual dose retained within the tumor.

role_evidence.quote: Each participant will receive a single administration of 186RNL.

agents.drug_class_hint: rhenium-186 nanoliposome radiopharmaceutical, delivered by convection-enhanced delivery

coder_notes: Retreatment study: all participants had a prior 186RNL dose. Convection-enhanced delivery catheter is a device but is the route of administration rather than an activating device, so device_dependent is false.
